textual_notes: These snippets are a direct, unverified image-grounded reinspection, not an independent blind first reading; the previous PR #30 provisional text grid was visible before this JSON was saved.
Exact literal physical lines are not claimed outside the explicitly line_fully_read=true entries. Quoted fragments must not be concatenated into fabricated text.
The first reproduction is a seventeenth-century printed source as shown by Franko, not automatically a manuscript witness. The Ukrainian caption is Franko's separate voice.
None of the 71 previously unresolved slots was silently resolved by borrowing a parallel Life of Mary of Egypt. This record is strictly a reading-aid pending complete line-by-line native-image text.
Enlargement was pixel repetition, not ML-enhanced super-resolution. Small titla and diacritics can remain unresolvable at source-image resolution.

Failure-oriented internal source recheck corrected two unsupported over-specific assertions: an L11 fragment and exact right-column line indices. The preserved earlier data commit bff23b6 records the pre-review working hypothesis.

A red-first review gate demonstrated that L01–L03 were falsely labelled entire-line readings while their titla had not been independently checked; changed to `line_fully_read=false` without altering raw hypotheses.
